indexes.expression: CREATE INDEX comment_visible_children_idx ON public.comment USING btree (review_id, parent_id, created_at, id) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
CREATE INDEX review_author_visible_idx ON public.review USING btree (author_id, created_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
CREATE INDEX review_release_visible_idx ON public.review USING btree (release_id, created_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
